jobs.description_text: The GTM Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across EMEA to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible. You’ll independently own the performance improvement cycle for the teams you support: diagnose → prescribe → activate → reinforce → measure → adjust. You’ll combine business results, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify where teams and individuals need support. You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed. jobs.title: Staff Developer, Authentication Enablement
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Staff Developer to join our Authentication Enablement team. Our mission is to help people, families and businesses unlock 1Password and access their information safely and simply, with authentication that stays in the background. Every 1Password app establishes its session with our servers through the service this team owns, whether the user signs in with a password and Secret Key, SSO, a passkey, MFA or a trusted device. As a Staff Developer, you’ll help move authentication out of the monolith and into an independent service with its own data, so sign-in can scale and stay available independently of the rest of the platform. The service continues to handle production traffic throughout the migration, so we’re moving endpoint by endpoint and table by table, with weighted rollouts, consistency checks and tested rollback procedures. You'll help set the technical direction for the migration and for new authentication services, as 1Password extends trusted access to AI agents. They run continuously, at machine speed, against live production environments. Until recently, nobody could put a nation-state-caliber adversary inside every network around the clock. That's the hyperattack, and it's what we do. In one recent engagement, the swarm generated more than 17 million offensive actions in three days and validated 38 attack paths. That's the scale your tradecraft will run at. As a Principal Red Team Operator, your tradecraft is the training signal. The quality and impact of research depends to a great extent on the organization in which it happens: how research teams are formed, how collaboration is structured, how resources and spaces are organized, and how the institution responds to uncertainty and new ideas. The Research Operations Manager will own and improve the core systems through which Basis’ research organization functions, across people, recruiting, labs and workplaces, research gatherings, grants, and administration. We are looking for someone who treats operations as a serious craft: someone who enjoys creating coherent structures around exploratory work, making sound decisions, and using thoughtful process design, tools, and automation to translate organizational principles into practices that accelerate our work. This is a broad and hands-on role, requiring both rigorous execution and thoughtful institutional design. You will work closely with the COO and assume independent ownership of major operational domains, identifying problems, weighing tradeoffs, establishing standards, and remaining accountable for outcomes. WE EXPECT YOU TO: - Have demonstrated the ability to own important operational domains and run them reliably over time. - Exercise sound judgment and operate with a high degree of autonomy, including under uncertainty. - Take the details of execution seriously. jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE The objective of this role is to turn interest in Basis into signed, funded partnerships: more of them, closed faster, with nothing lost along the way. Basis works with partners, customers, funders and investors on research collaborations, pilots and longer-term contracts. The founders and project leads own those relationships. Schedule the meetings, send the follow-ups, take contracts from first draft to signature, and prepare the weekly review of where things stand and what needs a decision. - Scale Basis's business opportunities. Start more of the right conversations, sooner: research prospective partners and funders, keep inbound interest warm, and prepare the founders for events and introductions. - Scale the business operations infrastructure. Build the CRM, templates, automations and reporting that let a small team handle many deals, using AI tools wherever they help. Each deal will have one person responsible for what happens next, and often that person will be you. It is an early point in the life of Basis, and the systems you set up now will be the ones we scale with. WE EXPECT YOU TO: - Finish what you start. jobs.description_text: ABOUT ASTERA Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at https://astera.org/visionastera.org/vision http://astera.org/vision. ABOUT THE ROBOTICS LAB We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action. Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence. jobs.title: Research Specialist, Experimental Neuroscience
jobs.description_text: COMPANY OVERVIEW Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy. POSITION SUMMARY We are seeking Research Specialists to help carry out experiments investigating how the brain supports perception, cognition, and behavior. Working alongside scientists, engineers, and technicians, you will support the day-to-day experimental work of our neuroscience team, preparing and running experiments, training animals, and maintaining experimental setups. We welcome people at different career stages who enjoy hands-on laboratory work and want to make it their main focus, including people from research support, lab management, and

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (PCS)
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Mechanical Design Engineer on the Power Conversion System (PCS), you will design the hardware that turns a set of individually developed machines (turbomachinery, motor-generator, recuperator, and primary heat exchanger) into one installed, testable, and operable power plant. Your design scope covers the working-fluid pressure boundary, the structural and layout architecture that carries and aligns the rotating machinery, and the high-temperature hardware that must survive it. This role resolves what happens between the components: routing, supports, thermal growth, leak-tightness, access, and assembly sequence. You will hold the mechanical arrangement and the pressure budget, work the mechanical interfaces to the major PCS components and to the reactor and safety systems, and carry that hardware from concept through fabrication, assembly, and test. You will support test rig design and instrumentation placement, then take what the data says about component life and performance into the next design revision. The ideal candidate has taken gas-loop, pressure-boundary, or rotating-machinery hardware from concept through fabrication and test, is comfortable designing to low leak requirements and thermal growth as hard requirements rather than afterthoughts, and does their best work when the requirements are still moving. Baseten owns the entire pipeline, from the moment a developer pushes a model to the moment a request gets a response. That vertical ownership means we can fix these problems at the root. As Engineering Manager for Storage Products on the Runtime Fabric team, you will lead the engineers who build and run the storage products behind that stack: the Baseten Delivery Network (BDN), which sits in the cold start path of every model on the platform, the snapshotters and filesystems that expose model weights and container images to a running container, and the storage that model deployment and training need next. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Compute & Isolation
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes gets its own microVM, where it writes and runs code, calls tools, and keeps state across long tasks. Agents pause and resume constantly, so the machine underneath has to start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume fast, and keep every tenant isolated while it does. General-purpose virtualization was not built for that workload. The Agent Infra team builds that layer. Sandboxes run in microVMs with custom Linux kernels on bare-metal servers we operate. You'll own how sandboxes start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume, and how they perform on each host's CPU and memory, down to the hardware. You'll also own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to different storage classes for performance or capabilities, and the virtual devices that connect it securely to the network. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose microVM sandboxes are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. The Agent Infra team builds its own networking stack for sandboxes, designed from the start for that scale. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files. The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk. You will take ambiguous problems, structure them, dig into the details, align senior stakeholders, and drive execution across teams that don’t report to you.
